versions.changelog:
Initial release of tech-proposal-autopilot: fully automated technical proposal writing with multi-agent collaboration and breakpoint continuation.  

- Enables multiple agents (milo, josh, dev, marketing) to collaborate on large technical proposal documents, each handling separate chapters.
- Supports fully automated, interruption-free workflow: auto-continue mechanism resumes progress after context limits, no user input required.
- Progress is persisted to project files (progress.json, CONTINUE.md), ensuring safe recovery and cross-session continuation.
- Triple trigger mechanism (heartbeat, scheduled cron, and agent request) ensures timely continuation and completion.
- Demonstrated at scale with verified use in large real-world projects (10–18 chapters, up to 310,000 words).
- Provides clear folder/file structure, status tracking, and logs for process transparency.
